headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving profit gains for several firms.
summary: Coforge posted the strongest top‑line expansion at 53.6% YoY, while Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance after modest 1.5% revenue growth. Most peers delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑related deals and higher operating margins. Profit growth was broadly healthy, led by HCLTech's 21% jump and TCS's steady margin expansion.

themes.title: AI‑enabled revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed significant top‑line and profit uplift, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins improved for several firms, notably TCS at 24% and HCLTech rising to 18.2% in constant currency.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit rise and strong AI revenue.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
